name: Sacra Publica
note: Ritual obligations performed on behalf of the Roman community.

name: Priestly Colleges
note: Pontifices augurs quindecimviri and epulones maintained public ritual knowledge.

name: Public Auspices
note: Magistrates sought and interpreted auspices before public action.

name: Household Cults
note: Lares Penates and household rites bound family subsistence and continuity.

name: Cult of Augustus
note: Provincial and municipal imperial cult linked loyalty to Rome and the imperial house.

name: Interpretatio Romana
note: Roman communities identified foreign gods with familiar divine powers while retaining local cult.

name: Vows and Public Games
note: Vota festivals and public games made reciprocal obligations to the gods visible.

name: Expiation of Prodigies
note: Reported prodigies were investigated and expiated through authorized civic ritual.
